# Yu Xi Chau

> Engineering notes, interactive data projects, and governance thinking from Yu Xi Chau — an AI leader and applied mathematician based in Hong Kong.

## Profile
- **Name:** Yu Xi Chau
- **Location:** Hong Kong
- **Current Role:** AI leadership at FWD Insurance (GenAI applications, RAG, agentic workflows, production readiness, and AI governance). Views on this site are personal and do not represent FWD Insurance or any other employer.
- **Academic Background:** PhD in Applied Mathematics (Complexity Science). Co-author of *Explosive condensation in symmetric mass transport models* (arXiv:1508.07516).
- **Focus Areas:** AI systems engineering, practical AI governance in regulated organisations, and applied AI in financial services and complex enterprises.
- **Profiles:** [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yuxichau/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/yuxichau) · [RSS](https://yuxichau.com/feed.xml)

## Featured Interactive Projects
- [LLM Intelligence vs Cost](https://yuxichau.com/projects/llm-model-analysis/): Pareto frontier of 150+ language models plotted by intelligence vs task cost.
- [Measuring Bias in Jev](https://yuxichau.com/projects/measuring-bias-in-jev/): Interactive calibration and bias audit of the Type Safe Jev model.
- [Sumo Elo History](https://yuxichau.com/projects/sumo-elo/): All-division professional sumo Elo explorer from 1958 onward.
- [Explosive Condensation](https://yuxichau.com/projects/explosive-condensation/): Interactive ring simulation of nonlinear mass-transport condensation.
